base_branch.description: the pair's base branch, the public branch it works against: public_branch from the overlay config, main when the key is missing

public_main.description: the public base branch's tip (the name says main on every pair)

shadow_main_before.description: the shadow's base branch's tip before sync

shadow_main_after.description: where sync left the shadow's base branch; when action is push_failed, the SHA sync read

to.description: in a dry run, the SHA the push would set

cancelled_runs.description: workflow runs this sync's own pushes started in the shadow repo, which it cancelled: push-triggered CI re-testing code public CI already tested (PUSH_TRIGGERS_ON_SYNC in ghostbranch audit says how to stop them); empty with --no-cancel or when none started

closed.description: merged features sync closed (never in a dry run: the preview has their ops)

deleted.description: each shadow ref deleted, with the SHA it pointed at

reparented.description: children moved onto the base branch (their parent is main now) in the push that closed it

surveyed.description: whether sync surveyed the features: false with --no-close or when the survey failed, and then active_features and attention say nothing

active_features.description: features not abandoned and not closable by sync; 0 unless surveyed

attention.description: merged_moved, pr_closed, branch_gone and unreadable features, merged features whose record is newer, merged features sync left open because another feature's record can't be read, and stacked features whose public branch holds changes Ghostbranch didn't publish (PUBLIC_BRANCH_CHANGED): a person must look at them
